result.description:
Lead enterprise architecture and governance for a major ERP transformation program within a federal government   Your new company     Join a major federal government organisation delivering a significant enterprise transformation programme. As part of a large and complex ICT environment, you will play a key role in shaping the future technology landscape, ensuring enterprise platforms, integrations, security controls, and business processes align with strategic objectives. This is an opportunity to work on a high-profile ERP programme that will have a lasting impact across the organisation.      Your new role     As an Enterprise Architect (EL2 equivalent), you will provide architecture leadership, governance, and assurance across a major ERP transformation initiative. Working closely with business stakeholders, cybersecurity teams, vendors, implementation partners, and technical leaders, you will ensure enterprise solutions align with strategic architecture principles and organisational goals. 
 You will develop and maintain enterprise architecture artefacts, provide oversight of integration and data architecture, support identity and access management design, and review solution architectures to ensure alignment with enterprise standards. You will also provide architecture advice to governance forums, identify risks and dependencies, and contribute to strategic decision-making throughout the programme life cycle. 
 This role is ideal for an experienced Enterprise Architect with a strong background in ERP programmes, integration architecture, cloud technologies, and enterprise governance. 
   What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Demonstrated experience delivering Enterprise Architecture services within large and complex environments 
 Strong ERP transformation experience, including architecture governance and design assurance 
 Experience across integration architecture, APIs, middleware, identity management, and data architecture 
 Knowledge of cloud solutions, cybersecurity frameworks, and enterprise architecture principles 
 Experience reviewing and assuring vendor and implementation partner designs 
 Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills 
 Experience with Workday, ServiceNow, SAP, or similar enterprise platforms is highly desirable 
 Ability to develop architectural artefacts, transition-state roadmaps, and governance documentation 
 Australian Citizenship with the ability to obtain NV1 Security Clearance 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Initial 6-month contract with 2 x 6-month extension options 
 Opportunity to work on a major enterprise-wide ERP transformation programme 
 Hybrid working arrangements with ACT location 
 Exposure to modern cloud, integration, cybersecurity, and enterprise architecture initiatives 
 High-profile role engaging with senior executives, architecture boards, and implementation partners 
 Collaborative environment with significant strategic influence 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call me now on 02 6112 7695 or email Aanchal.Dwivedi@hays.com.au. 
 If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact me for a confidential discussion about your career.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
IT Desktop Support position available within SQS Group in all states, work assignment may either be in NSW, QLD, SA, VIC, or WA

Southern Steel Group and its subsidiaries specialise in providing the nest steel products, sheet & coil, and expert steel processing and distribution. Our company network is extensive, represented in every Australian state.

Southern Queensland Steel is part of the Southern Steel Group, the largest privately-owned steel company in Australia. With more than 1400 employees nationwide, the foundations of this company are built on strong values and a sense of family belonging.

We service our customers through multiple SQS businesses and division affiliates in various States in Australia. In NSW: Steelpipes, Piling Solutions Australia, Rigby Jones, Rollco, Metal Shop Technics, Southern Sheet & Coil, Coil Processors. In QLD: RPG Australia. In Victoria: Surdex Steel, Smithweld Bending, KOMO Metform Engineering, Alliance Laser, Surdex Sheet & Coil, Eliott Engineering, Australian Rollforming Manufacturers. In SA: Brice Metals, Ferrocut. In WA: WA Cutting Services, Boyd Metal Industries

To succeed in this position, you will need to have industry related experience within similar positions, a strong work ethic and strong safety focus. The ability to carry out work with minimal supervision, a keen and enthusiastic approach to your work and willingness to work over time will help you ensure success in this role.

MAIN OBJECTIVE
To provide 1st and 2nd level IT helpdesk support on all end user equipment and systems for all users across the business.

DUTIES
Providing 1st/2nd level telephone and customer-facing support for initial fault diagnosis
The creation and deletion of new users across all internal systems
Setup of all new mobile/tablet devices
Install, configure and maintain network devices including but not restricted to PCs, Printers, Print Servers, Terminal Servers, Switches and application software
Hardware relocations and re-configurations (eg. PCs and telephones)
Monitoring and reporting on hardware, software and network resources to ensure a high level of performance, security and integrity
Assisting with the administration and support of the local area network, servers and printing facilities
Work within strict time frames and elevate incidents within defined timeframes
Creating, managing and supporting SOE builds for Desktop and Laptop PC’s
Maintain a good working knowledge of current infrastructure and future trends
All employees are subject to legal obligations regarding their own and their fellow workers Work Health & Safety (WH&S). They are to fully co-operate with the company WH&S Policy and Program, to ensure safety in the workplace is maintained. All employees shall undertake hazard identification as part of their normal duties, and report any unsafe conditions or work practices. All employees are responsible for their own safety as well as those around them.

SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED
Windows 7/10/11, Windows Server 2008/2012R2/2016/2019/2022, Active Directory (DNS, DHCP, etc)
Experience with Windows, iPhone, Android phones
Experience using a variety of PC software including the Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Exchange, Windows servers and desktops, and anti-virus software
Experience in security administration utilising active directory and group policy
Knowledge and understanding of end user requirements
Excellent communication skills with the ability to build strong working relationships
Strong customer service orientation
A professional, reliable and team orientated approach to work
MS HyperV/VMware
Experience with remote software tools such as TeamViewer, LogMein
Good understanding of Networking, TCP/IP and WiFi environments
Knowledge of Linux/UNIX would be an advantage
Experience with supporting HP SAN technology would be an advantage
Experience with HP Server Products
Understanding of Agile, Kanban methodologies

The successful applicant will be joining a secure, reputable organisation who o er their employees’ opportunities for career progression.

If you have the skills & experience, we need and have a positive attitude, please apply now.

Note: Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. We promote a safe work culture; therefore, we have a process of reference checking and pre-employment medicals which includes a drug and alcohol screen for the successful applicant.

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
